python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re
p='crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs'
s=open(p).read()
reps=[
("names each earlier job, how its result is addressed, its deliverables and out_of_scope, and lists or excludes each file it changed","names each earlier job, how its result is addressed, deliverables, out_of_scope, and each file it changed kept or excluded"),
("list it and name it in a criterion, or name it in out_of_scope","list it and name it in a criterion, or in out_of_scope"),
("a CI workflow, push, PR or pull request, or records-branch","a CI workflow, push, PR, or records-branch"),
("define each structural term the request uses (ladder","define each structural term in the request (ladder"),
("needs `Consumers: <deliverable paths>` or","needs `Consumers: <paths>` or"),
("a change to throughput, keep rule","changing throughput, keep rule"),
("a capability needs a criterion; forecasts are valid","a capability needs a criterion; valid forecasts"),
("targets only the roles under Enabled roles; others get no new content (prose only)","targets only roles under Enabled roles (prose only)"),

    s=s.replace(a,b)
